disclaimer_summary: Cases built with gtopt's own conversion tools, verified only as far as the authors can, NOT validated by the publishing institutions; provided AS IS without warranty; never to be used as a reference for analysing official operation scheduling or for financial analysis.
description: Machine-readable index of the gtopt case collection (INPUTS ONLY: source data, gtopt case inputs and how to run them; no results). One entry per case. Paths are relative to the repo root (case_json relative to the case path); run commands assume REPO=<this checkout>.
revisions_note: converter.gtopt_revision, converter.converter_last_change and size.lp.gtopt_revision record the gtopt development revision used for the conversion or the LP-size check (pre-publication history; may not exist in the public repository https://github.com/gtopt-community/gtopt). To rebuild a case, use the named converter from gtopt master of November 2026 or later.
